title: Black and Jade Green Dye

sources.title: Dyes
markers: '''Dyes''' are [[Consumables]] that can [[Combining|combined]] with various [[Equipment]] and [[Clothing]] items in the game to change their base colour to that of the dye in question. The full list of dyes can be found below.

summary: Consume the dye through Combine to recolour a piece of equipment.

fields.Use: Consume the dye through Combine to recolour a piece of equipment.
fields.Base value: 6 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
